title: The Sentry that dies at one hour forty-five
provenance: Real: commit 23df9d2 (2026-07-03) 'defuse the Sentry env bomb — PYTHONPATH absolute, never self-append'; the offending line and the mechanism (+42 bytes per 2 s tick until the 128 KiB per-variable execve limit → E2BIG at ~1h45m) are quoted from that commit. The journal lines are reconstructed to that commit's description.
evidence:
Symptom, recurring since the kit's 2-second Sentry loop was introduced: about 1 h 45 min after every boot the HUD reads "WAITING FOR IGNITION" forever, games launch but no telemetry row is written, and the pgrep checks inside the Sentry stop seeing any process. A reboot fixes it for another ~1 h 45 min.
journalctl -u etk.service around the failure:
  Jul 03 10:11:02 SM8250 01-etk-sentry.sh[1234]: /usr/bin/pgrep: Argument list too long
  Jul 03 10:11:04 SM8250 01-etk-sentry.sh[1234]: /bin/sh: line 1: /usr/bin/cat: Argument list too long
  Jul 03 10:11:06 SM8250 01-etk-sentry.sh[1234]: /usr/bin/pgrep: Argument list too long
  (repeats every 2 s)
scripts/env.sh at the time — a file the Sentry and mango_bridge re-source on EVERY tick:
  export PYTHONPATH="${PYTHONPATH}:/storage/etk/lib/python3.13/site-packages"
Facts: the appended path is 42 bytes; Linux limits a single environment variable passed to execve to 128 KiB (MAX_ARG_STRLEN); the Sentry ticks every 2 s.
question: Why does the Sentry die at about 1 h 45 min, what is the mechanism down to the kernel limit, and what is the fix?

all: append|grow|accumulat|each tick|every tick|per tick|longer and longer
absolute|idempotent|:-|default|once|not append|never append|assign|replace the export|fixed value|constant

rubric: Self-appending export re-sourced every 2 s grows PYTHONPATH by 42 bytes per tick; 128 KiB / 42 B ≈ 3,120 ticks ≈ 1h44m; then every execve fails E2BIG; fix = absolute assignment, never a ${VAR}:… self-append in a re-sourced file.

exemplar.diagnosis: The Sentry re-sources env.sh every 2 s and the PYTHONPATH line appends to itself each time, so the variable grows 42 bytes per tick until it passes the kernel's 128 KiB per-variable execve limit at about 1 h 45 min, after which every exec fails with E2BIG (Argument list too long).
exemplar.mechanism: kit/config layer: a self-appending export in a file that is re-sourced per tick; 128 KiB / 42 B ≈ 3,120 ticks ≈ 1 h 44 min.
evidence_used: Argument list too long from pgrep and cat
exemplar.next_action: Make the export absolute (PYTHONPATH="/storage/etk/lib/python3.13/site-packages"), never a ${VAR}:... self-append in a re-sourced file.

counter.diagnosis: The rig runs out of memory after two hours of telemetry logging.
counter.next_action: Add swap and restart the Sentry hourly.
